_comment: Which paths must never be published, as data.
The owner's instruction (2026-11-26): the working papers -- the gap ledger and the plan -- cannot become
public by any route. Since 2026-11-27 the rule is the whole directory: `workspace/` holds the owner's
material (working papers, compliance ledger, local conan recipes, vendored upstream trees) and **no code**,
because the execution surface moved to `.github/project/qa/`. That makes one pattern both sufficient and
exact, and it is the same line the template's own `.gitignore` already carries: `/workspace/`.
`procdocs_gate.py` enforces it from the index side and this list is the only place the set is written down.
为什么是数据而不是写在门禁里：这份集合会变（新的过程文档会出现），而「哪些东西不能公开」是业主的决定，
不该埋在代码的判断里。改这里等于改一条安全属性，所以门禁对每一条都要求 .gitignore 里也有对应规则——
两个独立的锁，缺一个就红。
2026-11-27 起规则收紧成整个目录：`workspace/` 里只有业主的材料（过程文档、合规台账、本地 conan 配方、
随仓上游代码），**不再有代码**——执行面已经搬到 `.github/project/qa/`。于是一条模式既充分又精确，
而且正是模板自带 `.gitignore` 里那条 `/workspace/`。
Patterns use a simple intent: `dir/**` protects the directory and everything below it;
`prefix/*.md` protects the matches directly in `prefix`; anything else is a plain glob.
The earlier warning against `workspace/**` ('that would protect the code, which is the opposite of the
point') is retired: that is exactly what we want now, because the code is no longer there.
why: process material: self-criticism, internal sequencing, owner instructions, and since 2026-11-27 also the compliance ledger and the local conan recipes. The whole directory is local-only; the code it used to hold is published under .github/project/qa/.
why_markdown: Documents whose whole value is being readable: a table that renders as bare `|` text is not a ledger.
The gap ledger grew by appending single rows separated by blank lines; a Markdown table ends at the first blank
line, so most of it rendered as prose (owner: "preview 不出来", 2026-11-26). P4/P5 keep it that way.
